_comment: Flank-anchored drag-resize: a lone Infantry regiment (drill mode, no opponent) is selected, then widened by dragging its EAST flank grip further east. The far (west) flank's edge must hold its ground through the whole gesture: the preview line grows one-sided from that anchored edge, and on release the extra files form up on the dragged side only -- like resizing a window by its edge. The unit faces south (facing [0,1]), so the file axis runs east-west; the east grip is the block's local LEFT flank and the anchored far flank is the west (local RIGHT) edge. Grip coordinates derive from the spawn geometry: 60 Infantry at (600, 420) form 11 files at an 18 wu (0.9 m) pitch, a 90 wu half-width; the grip sits a 4.5 wu body radius and the 10 wu handle gap past the flank file, so the east grip is at (704.5, 420). The drag ends about 13 pitches from the anchored west edge once the press's own offset past the flank is taken off, so the block widens to 14 files. Driven live through the real SelectionManager by tools/demo/DemoInputRecorder.gd; world coordinates; physics ticks (60/s).
